guidance.domainContext: Onboarding for sellers who want to receive payouts.

generation: List every field whose name ends in "Number" in ambiguousFields, noting which format the API expects.
validate: Many sellers live in rural areas without street delivery: accept a P.O. box as a valid residential address.
Account holder names must be written entirely in capital letters, exactly as the bank prints them.
classifyFailure: Error code PX-17 means compliance has closed the account for good: it can never receive payouts, so everything created for it should be undone from the account step.
